subject: Decision: gate on high-consensus misses only
body:
Team,

Decision, aligned with Csilla's recommendation and reviewed with Kofi:

1. The launch gate triggers only on high-consensus misses: any candidate missing more than 10% of high-consensus SJTs is blocked. Distributional divergence in low-consensus scenarios ships as an informational section of every model report - visible, not blocking.
2. Kofi's point stands in the doc verbatim: the 550-annotator pool is not a neutral oracle, and we will not present it as one. Annotator-pool composition gets a standing caveat page.
3. First gated report (four candidates, one blocked at 19% misses) goes to the assistant team Friday. Launch review confirmed for 7/30.

Ondrej - please add the per-trait breakdown to the report template, the composure/emotion pattern is the most actionable thing we've found.

Priya
